# 100.00 USD bought at 1.35, the bank keeping 1.00 of it as its fee on the same
# account, with no balance stated anywhere.
#
# The purchase opens a cost basis for 100.00 at the 1.35 it states, and the
# fee, giving the purchase's position in this file, draws 1.00 of it: 99.00 is
# left, what the account holds. A fee giving no cost basis is refused (Q-050).
#
# A second purchase brings 60.00 and 40.00 in two splits with the same 1.00
# kept back, drawn on the 60.00: 99.00 again. A third brings 60.00 and 40.00
# with 70.00 paid straight back out — more than the first split brought — so
# the 70.00 is written as two splits, each drawing on one: 60.00 on the first
# and 10.00 on the second, leaving 30.00, what the account kept.
#
# `tests/fixtures/fx_usd_bought_with_the_banks_fee_drawn_on_it.txt` is the same
# purchase with `cost_basis_balance: "99.00"` stated.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_purchase_whose_fee_draws_on_it_leaves_what_the_account_holds.py.
2035-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2035-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2035-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2035-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2035-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2035-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2035-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2035-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2035-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2035-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -1000.00 CAD

2035-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35, the bank keeping 1.00 USD as its fee"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "135.00"
	Assets:USD Bank -1.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-1.35"
		cost_basis_split_guid: $transactions_to_import[1].splits[0].guid$
	Expenses:Bank Fees 1.35 CAD
	Assets:CAD Bank -135.00 CAD

2035-01-30 * "Buy 60 and 40 USD at 1.35 in one, 70.00 USD of it paid straight back out"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 60.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "81.00"
	Assets:USD Bank 40.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "54.00"
	Assets:USD Bank -60.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-81.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: $transactions_to_import[2].splits[0].guid$
	Assets:USD Bank -10.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-13.50"
		cost_basis_split_guid: $transactions_to_import[2].splits[1].guid$
	Expenses:Bank Fees 94.50 CAD
	Assets:CAD Bank -135.00 CAD

2035-01-20 * "Buy 60 and 40 USD at 1.35 in one, the bank keeping 1.00 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 60.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "81.00"
	Assets:USD Bank 40.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "54.00"
	Assets:USD Bank -1.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-1.35"
		cost_basis_split_guid: $transactions_to_import[3].splits[0].guid$
	Expenses:Bank Fees 1.35 CAD
	Assets:CAD Bank -135.00 CAD
